title: Collector not receiving data
body: I have tried both the latest release version of xdrip and the latest daily release and both have the same problem.  I have a Galaxy s20 running android 10 and a bubble reader for my libre sensor.  The bluetooth scan finds the bubble reader and connects to it.  The status page has all the correct information about the reader and sensor.  However the Collecting Initial Readings never gets passed the Data Collector Running stage.  There is always an hour glass in front of the Receiving Data from Bubble Collector stage.  I have tried several times to uninstall and re-install the app, I have tried forget the device and re-connected.  I have tried using a magnet to reset the bubble and then re-connect.  All have the same end result.  Can anyone tell me what is wrong  with my setup?

comments.body: I have now looked at the error log and can see that data packets are being sent but have checksum errors.  My bubble is hardware version 2.0 firmware version 3.3.  I can run DiaBox and it reads and displays the data correctly but it will not communicate with my fitbit ionic smartwatch.  I have not tried having both DiaBox and xdrip installed at the same time.  Either one or the other.

Is this an xDrip bug?
If the functionality is lost due to a change to a Google app or anything else, it's not fair to call it an xDrip bug. Sure, we may be able to modify xDrip to fix the problem.  But, that should be categorized as a feature request rather than a bug.

@Navid200 It is a bug in the xDrip code supporting the bubble transmitter and has nothing to do with the removal of the Diabox app from Play Store. But only the @bubbledevteam can fix it. It looks like it is related to the checksum calculation.

I have added the status-waiting label.  I hope that is a correct label.  It sounds like we are waiting for an external party to make a change to something we have no control over.
In the meantime, while we wait, I would like to close this issue.
Is there a reason we should leave it open?

If we have to make a change to xDrip, perhaps add a note so that the users know a functionality does not exist any longer, please let me know and I will add the note.
